events.title: Is Palantir Technologies a Buy After Its Explosive Q1 2026 Earnings?
events.body: PLTR's explosive Q1 shows surging revenue, margins, and AI demand, but capacity limits and rising competition complicate the bullish case.

events.title: Gartner (IT) Tops Q1 Earnings Estimates
events.body: Gartner (IT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +11.21% and -0.58%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: CFOs On the Move: Week ending May 1
events.body: Puma appoints a new chief financial officer, Booz Allen Hamilton names a former Boeing exec as CFO and PPG hires Avient’s finance chief.
